Lakeview Resort — Destination Wedding Venue, Udaipur

Lakeview Resort is an Udaipur destination-wedding property overlooking a lake,
with poolside lawns, a banquet hall, and 80 rooms for guest accommodation. It is
a favorite for intimate-to-mid-size destination weddings.

The destination wedding package starts at ₹9,50,000 for a two-day buyout
covering venue, basic decor, and partial accommodation; full-property buyouts are
quoted on request. Catering is in-house.

Contact: +91 94150 60088 · weddings@lakeviewudaipur.example
Location: Fateh Sagar, Udaipur, Rajasthan
Rating: 4.8 / 5 (118 reviews)

What couples say:
"The lakeside backdrop was breathtaking for our pheras."

Lakeview Resort assigns a dedicated wedding coordinator and is experienced with
